name: erf
title: Error Functions and Inverses (Matlab Style)
description: The error function, computed as pchisq(2 x^2, 1) times the sign of x.
case: erf(c(-1, 0, 0.5, 1)) is the error function at those points.

name: erfc
title: Error Functions and Inverses (Matlab Style)
description: The complementary error function, 2 pnorm(-sqrt(2) x).
case: erfc(c(-0.5, 0, 1)) is the complementary error function.

name: erfcinv
title: Error Functions and Inverses (Matlab Style)
description: Inverse complementary error function, -qnorm(y/2) / sqrt(2). Values outside [0, 2] are missing.
case: erfcinv(c(0.2, 1, 1.7)) inverts the complementary error function.

name: erfcx
title: Error Functions and Inverses (Matlab Style)
description: Scaled complementary error function, exp(x^2) erfc(x).
case: erfcx(c(0, 0.5, 1.2)) is the scaled complementary error function.

name: erfi
title: Error Functions and Inverses (Matlab Style)
description: Imaginary error function. A real argument returns the real part of -i erfz(i z).
case: erfi(c(0, 0.4, 1)) is the imaginary error function.

name: erfinv
title: Error Functions and Inverses (Matlab Style)
description: Inverse error function, sqrt(qchisq(abs(y), 1) / 2) times the sign of y. Values outside [-1, 1] are missing.
case: erfinv(c(-0.5, 0, 0.5)) inverts the error function.

name: erfz
title: Error Functions and Inverses (Matlab Style)
description: Complex error function from the power series inside radius 5.8 and the asymptotic series outside it. Zero stays missing.
case: erfz(c(0.3, 1, 6)) uses the power series and the asymptotic series.

name: psi
title: Psi (Polygamma) Function
description: Polygamma of order k. With one argument this is the digamma function. A digamma vector hits R's non-vectorized && and errors.
case: psi(1, 2.5) is the trigamma function at 2.5.

name: expint
title: Exponential and Logarithmic Integral
description: Exponential integral E1. The series is used inside the rational boundary and a continued fraction outside it.
case: expint(c(0.5, 1, 3)) mixes the series and the continued fraction.

name: expint_E1
title: Exponential and Logarithmic Integral
description: Alias of expint, the exponential integral E1.
case: expint_E1(c(0.5, 1, 3)) is the same call as expint.

name: expint_Ei
title: Exponential and Logarithmic Integral
description: Exponential integral Ei. A non-positive imaginary part subtracts i pi from -E1(-x).
case: expint_Ei(c(0.4, 1.5)) is Ei on the positive reals.

name: li
title: Exponential and Logarithmic Integral
description: Logarithmic integral, Ei(log(x)).
case: li(c(2, 5)) is the logarithmic integral.

name: ellipke
title: Elliptic and Jacobi Elliptic Integrals
description: Complete elliptic integrals of the first kind k and the second kind e, from the arithmetic-geometric mean. The check vector is k then e.
case: ellipke(c(0.2, 0.5)) returns k then e.

name: ellipj
title: Elliptic and Jacobi Elliptic Integrals
description: Jacobi elliptic functions sn, cn, and dn. The check vector is sn, then cn, then dn.
case: ellipj(c(0.3, 0.8), 0.4) returns sn, cn, and dn.

name: gammaz
title: Complex Gamma Function
description: Gamma function from the Lanczos series, with the reflection formula for a negative real part.
case: gammaz(c(0.5, 1, 4, -0.5)) includes the reflection at -1/2.

name: gammainc
title: Incomplete Gamma Function
description: Lower, upper, and regularized lower incomplete gamma, from the series or the continued fraction. Not vectorized.
case: gammainc(1.5, 1) returns the lower, upper, and regularized values.

name: incgam
title: Incomplete Gamma Function
description: Upper incomplete gamma. Positive a uses the continued fraction for pgamma; a = 0 uses E1.
case: incgam(2.5, 3.2) is the upper incomplete gamma.

name: fresnelC
title: Fresnel Integrals
description: Normalized Fresnel cosine integral C(x), vectorized over the scalar series.
case: fresnelC(c(-0.5, 0.7, 1.2)) is the cosine Fresnel integral.

name: fresnelS
title: Fresnel Integrals
description: Normalized Fresnel sine integral S(x), vectorized over the scalar series.
case: fresnelS(c(-0.5, 0.7, 1.2)) is the sine Fresnel integral.

name: Ci
title: Sine and Cosine Integral Functions
description: Cosine integral. The source returns the real part only.
case: Ci(c(0.5, 1, 2)) is the cosine integral.

name: Si
title: Sine and Cosine Integral Functions
description: Sine integral. A negative argument changes the sign of Si and leaves Ci alone.
case: Si(c(-1, 0.5, 2)) is the sine integral, odd in the first entry.

name: eta
title: Dirichlet Eta Function
description: Dirichlet eta from the binomial series, with reflection through gammaz for real part below 1/2.
case: eta(c(0, 2, -1)) includes the value 1/2 at zero and the reflection at -1.

name: zeta
title: Riemann Zeta Function
description: Riemann zeta from eta. The point 1 is infinity.
case: zeta(c(0, 2, 3, -1)) includes zeta at zero and at -1.

name: polylog
title: Polylogarithm Function
description: Polylogarithm Li_n(z) for one real z with absolute value below 1 and an integer n at least -4.
case: polylog(0.5, 2) is the dilogarithm at one half.

name: lambertWn
title: Lambert's W Function
description: Real branch W-1 of Lambert's W, for -1/e <= x < 0, by Halley's iteration.
case: lambertWn(c(-0.1, -0.2)) is the W-1 branch.

name: lambertWp
title: Lambert's W Function
description: Principal real branch W0 of Lambert's W, for x >= -1/e, by Halley's iteration.
case: lambertWp(c(0, 0.5, 2)) is the principal branch.

name: bernoulli
title: Bernoulli Numbers and Polynomials
description: Bernoulli numbers B_n = -n zeta(1-n), with B1 set to -1/2. A second argument evaluates the polynomial.
case: bernoulli(6) returns B0 through B6.

name: legendre
title: Legendre Functions (Matlab Style)
description: Associated Legendre functions of degree n and orders 0 through n. The check vector reads the matrix down the columns.
case: legendre(3, c(0.2, 0.5)) is the degree-3 matrix, flattened down columns.

name: laguerre
title: Laguerre's Method
description: One root of a polynomial by Laguerre's method, starting near x0.
case: laguerre(c(1, -3, 2), 0.5) finds the root 1 of (x-1)(x-2).

name: einsteinF
title: Einstein Functions
description: Einstein function E1, E2, E3, or E4. A zero argument is replaced after the formula.
case: einsteinF(1, c(0, 1, 2)) is E1, with the zero argument set to 1.

name: fact
title: Factorial Function
description: Factorial by successive products. Values above 170 are infinite and negative values are NaN.

name: factorial2
title: Factorial Function
description: Double factorial, the product of the even or odd integers up to n. A vector longer than one is an error.
case: factorial2(6) is 2 * 4 * 6.
